course_description: This course focuses on data organization and architecture as well as managing the database. Topics include the basic functions of a data administrator, including database planning, analysis, design, implementation, maintenance and protection.

course_learning_outcomes.text: analyze business domains and identify appropriate database architecture and data model;
select suitable schema in designing and developing database solution architecture for an organization;
simulate the functions of database administrators throughout the information lifecycle;
administer data capture, management, storage and retrieval method;
design and implement appropriate database solution for an organization/company/department/unit; and
demonstrate 21st century skills in all learning activities.
